change: In the wide BF16 path only, increase kWideBf16XSecondPhaseBytes from 96B to 128B. The xBuf_ capacity and xSecondBufferOffset both use this constant; residual ping-pong phase and allocation request order are unchanged.
hypothesis: Moving only the second x/gamma ping-pong view by one additional 32B transfer-aligned phase may change relative UB placement and performance. No physical UB bank mapping is asserted.

static_validation.alignment: The added phase is 32B; the BF16 second-view element offset remains aligned because bytes are divided by sizeof(T)=2.
static_validation.bounds: For tileElems == tileWidth, the second view begins at tileWidth + phaseBytes/2 elements and its tile ends exactly at the allocation end 2*tileElems*sizeof(T)+phaseBytes. For a tail, valid <= tileWidth, so the view remains within capacity.
static_validation.budget: ChooseWideFullYRows includes kWideBf16XSecondPhaseBytes + kWideBf16ResidualSecondPhaseBytes, so the additional x phase is counted in the UB budget.
static_validation.scope: Only the BF16 wide-path x ping-pong phase changes; the residual phase, arithmetic, tiling, and synchronization are unchanged.
